title: TypeScript library source component diagram
description: The library's modules. The typed layer (0.3) sits on the JSON layer (0.2): every typed operation calls a JSON-layer function on its value's UTV JSON and turns the utv-result/1.0 answer into an Outcome. index.ts is the package's only entry point.

components.name: @utv/core source
components.responsibility: Everything the package compiles from: typed values and outcomes over the JSON-level everyday API, text form, validation and native interop.

components.name: Entry point (index.ts)
components.responsibility: Re-exports the public API of every module, and SPEC_VERSION and LIBRARY_VERSION.

components.name: Typed values and context (values.ts, context.ts)
components.responsibility: One immutable class per everyday value, valid by construction; parse and fromJson; TemporalContext, which holds the zone rules and orders zoned values.

components.name: Outcomes and policies (outcome.ts)
components.responsibility: Outcome<T> and its helpers, OutcomeError, assertNever, and the typed vocabularies Truth, Ordering, Weekday, MonthEnd, Gap, Overlap and ResolutionPolicy.

components.name: ISO text and text form (iso.ts, text.ts)
components.responsibility: parseIso and formatIso for points; parseText and formatText add ISO 8601 periods, bracket intervals and EDTF slash intervals on input.

components.name: Calendar and instant operations (ops.ts)
components.responsibility: fields, add, compare, daysBetween, posixSecondsBetween, contains and overlaps on UTV JSON.

components.name: Zone rules and resolution (zones.ts)
components.responsibility: Parses rule bundles into ZoneRules; resolve, toZone and toOffset between wall times and instants, never outside the bundle's window.

components.name: Native interop (native.ts)
components.responsibility: Explicit adapters to and from Date, epoch milliseconds and plain {year, month, day} objects, with the intent named and loss reported.

components.name: Builders (builders.ts)
components.responsibility: Assemble the canonical everyday JSON shapes; they do not validate.

components.name: Strict JSON and validation (json.ts, structural.ts, civil.ts)
components.responsibility: A JSON parser that rejects duplicate keys; structural validation of utv/1.0 envelopes; semantic validation of proleptic Gregorian civil values and the calendar arithmetic it rests on.

components.name: Result envelope (result.ts)
components.responsibility: The utv-result/1.0 UtvResult, Diagnostic and makeResult.

components.name: Readers, writers and exact numbers (internal.ts, rational.ts)
components.responsibility: Reads UTV JSON into checked internal records and writes it back; runs each operation so that failures become results; exact bigint rationals.

components.name: Node.js file system (node:fs)
components.responsibility: readFileSync, the one Node built-in the library uses, declared in src/node.d.ts.

components.name: JavaScript Date
components.responsibility: The standard date type the native adapters convert to and from.

relationships.description: The typed layer's outcomes and policies.
Re-exports the typed values, parse, fromJson and TemporalContext.
Re-exports ZoneRules, loadRules, resolve, toZone, toOffset.
Re-exports parseStrict, validateStructural, validateSemantic and the calendar functions.
Re-exports makeResult, candidate and the result types.
add, compare, fields, daysBetween, posixSecondsBetween, contains, overlaps.
resolve, toZone, toOffset; TemporalContext holds a ZoneRules.
toString is formatText; parse is parseText; inZone checks the zone name with ZONE_NAME.
Builds each value's JSON before reading it back.
fromJson parses text strictly and reports structural failures.
Reads and writes values; turns a Fail into an Outcome.
parseText and formatText use compare to reject reversed intervals.
ZoneRules.load reads the file the caller names with readFileSync.
fromDate with an offset or a zone uses toOffset and toZone.
fromDate reads getTime(); toDate constructs a Date from milliseconds.
Every reader checks the value structurally first (validateParsed).
run wraps every outcome in makeResult.
